1364: The shortest possible opening: a winter title and its original image, before the meaning of the orange mark has been written.
1361: The orange point is an ember of responsibility in a room whose floor becomes water. The writer discovers that staying need not mean forcing.
1352: A boundary around a small house becomes a condition for tenderness to survive, rather than an argument against contact.
1346: A lunchbox carries provision and warmth: a practical object turns into the possibility of travelling with oneself.
1332: A remembered date and a quiet room turn the orange point toward rest and the permission not to be in danger.
1298: Three garments organize changing states. The orange mark appears where one state gives way to another.
1291: The writer and the watcher occupy different parts of a fog-bound stage; vigilance is seen without having to govern the body.
1229: The furnished house opens at its seams, while an orange signal remains available without demanding that the house be repaired by force.
1209: An encounter from artistic youth is remembered as a contact that was abruptly cut. The body carries its small fire into language.
1175: The vigilant figure learns to hold contact without making it into a strategy.
1168: The tiny heat signal remains alive through piling up, withdrawing, and continuing. A deliberate reprise from First Readings.
1113: The orange dot becomes a pilot light. The page can record uncertainty without solving it.
951: Contact, pause and return appear as the natural rhythm of attention, rather than a failure of continuity.
890: The bodily impulse arrives before a thought and does not have to complete itself in another person.
873: Bee resists the premature settlement of meaning. The elements can meet without being made to fit.

776: Drawing keeps a question warm without requiring it to become a finished answer.
696: An apparently caring apparatus reveals the uneasy difference between holding someone and fixing someone in place.
597: N. doubts a room that explains itself too well; the orange frame is no longer allowed to decide the memory.

410: Bee attends to the undecided interval between presences, where an encounter is already happening without needing to become correct.
